page_title: SAS 0-3 LEC | Sassuolo v Lecce 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
87' The corner from Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) is cleared away by the defence.
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Armand Lauriente as he is replaced by Emil Konradsen Ceide (Sassuolo).
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce) is coming onto the pitch as Valentin Gendrey cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' Luca Gotti decides to make a substitution. Nikola Krstovic will be replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sassuolo comes to nothing.
80' The Lecce players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
77' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

76' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Andrea Consigli has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
75' Luca Gotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicola Sansone (Lecce) replacing Roberto Piccoli.
75' Substitution. Patrick Dorgu walks off the pitch and Medon Berisha (Lecce) comes on as a substitute.
74' Lecce are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
73' 7:4 – the corner kicks stats.
70' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

70' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
69' A pass from Remi Oudin (Lecce) is intercepted by Andrea Consigli and the move breaks down.

66' Excellent touch by Roberto Piccoli (Lecce)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
65' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kristian Thorstvedt.
63' It's a nice effort by Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Andrea Consigli. Easy save.
63' 6:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.
61' 0 - 3 Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) is released by Nikola Krstovic, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
60' The Sassuolo players are exchanging some short passes.
57' A cross from a corner kick by Sassuolo is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
56' Substitution. Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Hamza Rafia walks off.
54' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul after Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) hacks down one of his opponents.
52' Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
51' Sassuolo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
49' Remi Oudin (Lecce) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
48' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Davide Ballardini gives a chance to Samuele Mulattieri and Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo) is off.
46' The game is over for Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo). Cristian Volpato comes on for the second half.
46' Davide Ballardini has made a change at the break. Josh Doig has come on in place of Mattia Viti (Sassuolo).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone is equal to it and makes an easy save.
45+1' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+1' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
45+1' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo).
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Sassuolo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

43' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
42' Remi Oudin (Lecce) swings in a cross from the corner, but Andrea Consigli reads it well and gathers the ball.
41' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
41' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 6:8.
39' Great teamplay by Sassuolo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
36' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
34' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lecce.
33' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
31' Wladimiro Falcone leaps to intercept the corner kick from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo).
30' 0:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
29' Mattia Viti (Sassuolo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
27' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
26' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Sassuolo will take a throw-in.
25' Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.

24' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
24' Gregoire Defrel (Sassuolo) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
23' Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
22' Looks like Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
21' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) takes the corner but it's cleared.
21' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Sassuolo will have a corner.
20' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Remi Oudin (Lecce), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
19' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
17' Mattia Viti (Sassuolo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman signals a throw-in for Lecce.

15' 0 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Antonino Gallo, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Patrick Dorgu (Lecce), who beats Andrea Consigli with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 0:2.
13' The percentage of ball possession is – 52:48.

11' 0 - 1 Perfectly taken free kick! Remi Oudin sends a cross in and Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes into the middle of the net and the score changes to 0:1.
10' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.

8' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.

6' The corner from Remi Oudin evades the keeper, but Alexis Blin (Lecce) can't keep his close-range header down and fires it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
6' Remi Oudin (Lecce) takes the corner.
4' Neat passing move from Sassuolo in order to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
